regime: Relief Bounce / Chop (Indexes Reclaim Stops, Still Below EMA50)
summary: The four-day slide finally paused. The Nasdaq added 0.58 percent to 28,301 and the S&P 500 added 0.26 percent to 7,596.25, and both climbed back above the trailing stops they lost last week, the first repair signal in a week. The catch is that both stalled under their 50-hour averages and closed below session VWAP, so this reads as a relief bounce inside a trend that is still broken. December gold slipped 0.61 percent to 3,931.40, giving back part of Monday's jump after an overnight whipsaw, while December crude bounced 0.71 percent to 96.53 but stayed below its stop. VIX eased about 2.5 percent into the low 20s and the hourly ranges narrowed hard, and with midterm election results landing overnight, the tape is set up to gap on the open.

setups.name: AVWAP Midrange
setups.entry: Fade the edges of the opening range back toward the mean when price is boxed between AVWAP and the OR boundaries.
setups.stop: Beyond the opposite OR boundary (OR High 28,372.75 or OR Low 28,213.00).
setups.t1: The session mean near NYVWAP 28,341.91, then the opposite edge.
setups.bias: A failed opening-range break and a mid-range close put MNQ in balance, the setup this edge is built for. Chop between the OR boundaries favors fading the extremes.

setups.name: AVWAP Back Into Range (BIR)
setups.entry: A full-body hourly close back inside the OR after a break (no CPI, not Monday).
setups.stop: Beyond the swing that made the failed break.
setups.t1: The opposite OR boundary or the session mean.
setups.bias: MNQ printed the BIR structure today: an up-break at 15:54 UTC that failed and closed back inside by 16:15. The edge is eligible Tuesday.

setups.name: TSMOM-20
setups.entry: Trend-follow each instrument on its own ATR stop.
setups.stop: MNQ 28,104 and MES 7,567 for the fresh longs; crude short below 97.52; gold long on its 3,926 stop.
setups.t1: For the index longs, the EMA50 and VWAP overhead (MNQ 28,487, MES 7,615); for crude, the prior lows.
setups.bias: The index stops just flipped long at lower resets while crude stays short and gold sits on its stop. Signals are fresh and conflicting, so the edge is live but whippy.

setups.name: AVWAP Bounce
setups.entry: A reclaim and hold above AVWAP that then uses it as support.
setups.bias: Both indexes closed just below AVWAP, so a bounce-continuation long is not armed yet. A clean reclaim of VWAP would put it in play.

event.name: US midterm Election Day (results land overnight); JOLTS scheduled, federal data shutdown-delayed
event.consensus: Tuesday Nov 3 is Election Day for the US midterms, a known risk marker with results arriving overnight rather than during the cash session. JOLTS for September was set for 10:00 ET, but federal releases remain subject to shutdown-related delays, so the scheduled data slate is uncertain. The week's marquee release is the October jobs report on Friday Nov 6, also shutdown-contingent.
event.actual: Equities bounced for the first time in five sessions and both reclaimed their trailing stops, while gold gave back part of Monday's jump and crude bounced but stayed short.
event.surprise: The bounce stalled under the 50-hour averages and session VWAP, so it reads as relief rather than a clean turn. VIX eased into the low 20s and ranges narrowed sharply.
event.nqReaction: NQ added 0.58 percent to 28,301 and reclaimed its trailing stop at a lower reset, but an opening-range up-break at 15:54 UTC failed, price closed back inside the range and below NYVWAP 28,341.91, and it finished under its EMA50 at 28,487.
event.crossAsset: MES plus 0.26 percent at 7,596.25, also back above its stop. December gold minus 0.61 percent at 3,931.40, closing on its 3,926.52 stop after an overnight whipsaw. December crude plus 0.71 percent at 96.53, still below its 97.52 stop. VIX about 20.74, down roughly 2.5 percent.

observe.name: OBSERVE lane
observe.note: No OBSERVE-lane signals today. GAP_NQ and TSMOM252LO_NQ sit outside the Net Alpha Pro curriculum and are tracked for research only.

risk.sizing: Reduced. The indexes reclaimed their stops and volatility eased, so the hard defensive stance from the four-day selloff can step down a notch, but these are fresh longs stalled under the EMA50 on election night, so keep size modest and do not chase.
risk.openRisk: The index longs are reclaims that still have to clear the EMA50 and VWAP, so they can fail at resistance. Gold closed right on its stop and can re-flip short, and crude is still below its stop. Election results land overnight and can gap the open either way.
risk.note: Throttle state REDUCED, stepped down from DEFENSIVE after the indexes reclaimed their stops and VIX eased into the low 20s. No drawdown flags and the daily loss budget is unused. TSMOM is long the indexes above their stops (MNQ 28,104, MES 7,567) and short crude below 97.52; December gold is a coin-flip long on its 3,926 stop. The long-only momentum edge (E3v2) stays blocked with price under the EMA50. Week ahead: the October jobs report is due Friday Nov 6 but remains shutdown-contingent, and the next policy event is the December FOMC. Treat the post-election open as an event open and let the first opening-range break prove itself.

psychology: A reclaim is a pause signal before it is a buy signal. Both indexes climbed back above the trailing stop they lost last week, and that is worth respecting. It tells you the easy short is done for now. It does not tell you the trend has turned, because price stalled right under the 50-hour average and the session VWAP and closed mid-range. The hard part on a bounce day is sitting still when you want to call the bottom. Let the level do the work. If price can hold above VWAP and the EMA50 for a couple of hours, the repair earns some trust. Until then, keep size small and let the market prove it, especially with election results printing overnight.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
Balance day: a failed opening-range break. OR High 28,372.75, OR Low 28,213.00, Width 159.75 pts (0.56 percent).

Anchored at the 14:30 UTC NY cash open (EST, after daylight saving ended Nov 1). Price broke above the range at 15:54 UTC to 28,391.50, but the break failed and price closed back inside the range by 16:15 UTC, a Back-in-Range (BIR) structure. The cash session finished 28,301, inside the opening range and below NYVWAP 28,341.91. It is Tuesday with no CPI or FOMC, so all four HTA OPEN playbooks are eligible today: BIR, HOF, MID and BNC. The day gave a BIR look off the failed up-break, and there was no clean directional hand-off because the break reversed. Volume is disclaimed on the continuous contract, so VWAP uses a typical-price mean.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout (Regime Filter)
fullReport.html:
SIGNAL BLOCKED on MNQ. Price closed 28,301, below EMA(50) at 28,487, so the long-only breakout gate stays shut even though ROC(12) is a small positive at plus 0.51 percent.

RVOL is not available (volume disclaimed on the continuous contract). The regime filter reads red while price is under the EMA50, so the long-only E3v2 edge does not fire. On a day the indexes only reclaimed a fast trailing stop and stalled at the 50-hour average, there is no momentum breakout to take.

There was no stretched touch of the minus 2 or minus 3 sigma band, so no reversion-grade setup formed. This is a low-volatility chop day where the mean-reversion edge is not in habitat; it needs a stretched tag and a reclaim, which did not happen.

fullReport.title: Yesterday's Map: Marked
fullReport.html:
Score: 5 rows, 4 triggered, 0 played out, 2 mixed, 2 failed, 1 not triggered. Month to date 7 of 10 triggered across two scored maps. Published Nov 2 for the Tuesday Nov 3 session. The map was set up for the downtrend to keep going, and the market bounced instead, so it scored poorly: four of five rows triggered but none played out. Both index stay-below-the-stop rows held as levels (neither reclaimed 28,495 or 7,634) but failed on direction as the indexes bounced and reclaimed their stops at lower resets. Gold whipsawed around its 3,932 line and closed on it (mixed), and crude stayed short but bounced instead of making new lows (mixed). The one not-triggered row was the MNQ reclaim of 28,495, which never set up. TRIGGERED means the IF happened; PLAYED OUT, MIXED or FAILED grade whether the THEN followed.

Scenario (IF)MarkGradeWhat happened
MNQ stays below the 28,495 flipped ATR stop and the 28,839 EMA50 on 2 hourly closesTRIGGEREDFAILEDMNQ stayed below 28,495 and the 28,839 EMA50 on every hourly close (session high 28,443.75), so the IF held. The down path did not. Price bounced off the open, held the 28,213 opening-range low and closed up 0.58 percent at 28,301, nowhere near the 28,101 low or the 28,000 round. The trailing stop even flipped long at a lower reset of 28,104, so the level held as resistance while the direction reversed.
MNQ reclaims the 28,495 stop and the 28,500 round on 2 hourly closesNOT TRIGGERED-Price never reached 28,495 or 28,500 (session high 28,443.75), so the clean reclaim the row specified did not set up. The ATR trailing stop did flip long, but at a lower 28,104 reset, below the 28,495 line this row named.
MES stays below the 7,634 flipped ATR stopTRIGGEREDFAILEDMES stayed below 7,634 all session (high 7,623.75), so the IF held, but it did not go heavy. It bounced to close 7,596.25, up 0.26 percent, and its low stopped at 7,582.5, above the 7,570.75 target. The stop line held as resistance while the downside reversed.
December gold holds above the 3,932 flipped ATR stop and the 3,950 roundTRIGGEREDMIXEDGold did not hold the levels cleanly. It lost the 3,932 stop overnight and flipped short to a 3,904.10 low, the row's re-flip-short clause, then reclaimed 3,932 midday and closed 3,931.40, right on the stop and below the 3,950 round. Neither the 3,980.90 upside nor a clean 3,900 downside delivered. A whipsaw that ended on the line.
December crude stays below the 98.28 flipped ATR stopTRIGGEREDMIXEDCrude spent the cash session below 98.28 and kept its short, but it did not press to new lows. After a brief overnight poke to a 98.55 close that failed, it flushed to a 93.60 low then recovered to close 96.53, up 0.71 percent. The low held at 95.53, above the 95.13 target. Short intact, downside stalled.
